assertions.name: no_i8_violations
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no substrate-pure script leaks float64)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every substrate-pure-banner script keeps its derived mpf values through the final witness emit without precision loss.

description: I8 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: scripts whose docstrings claim substrate-pure / canonical / 50-dps precision are scanned for float64 leaks — `np.float64(...)`, `float(...)` casts on derived mpf values, f-string precision clipping, and `==` comparison on mpf values. Antipattern shapes are matched against the four catalogue items. False-positive guards: lines inside builder `add_data` / `add_parameter` / `add_assertion` calls are classified as `ok_witness_emit` (final-step JSON serialization is expected); lines followed within 3 by `mp.mpf(str(...))` re-wrap are `false_positive_candidate`.
